reviewed_by: Codex manual causal source, pinned original tests, and command review 2026-10-25
review_notes: When moving the last cache node out of the head frequency node, advance freq_link_head to its new frequency node before unlinking the empty old node. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'deepdiff/lfucache.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('deepdiff.lfucache')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from deepdiff.lfucache import LFUCache
cache=LFUCache(1)
cache.set("first",value="one")
assert cache.get("first")=="one"
print("head_after_promotion",cache.freq_link_head.freq)
assert cache.freq_link_head.freq==1
cache.set("second",value="two")
assert "first" not in cache
assert cache.get("second")=="two"
print("promotion_then_eviction_preserves_head",True)
PYREPLAY
